body:
FORMAL UX / ACCESSIBILITY / VISUAL REVIEW — APPROVE

Reviewer: codex-mockup-ux-review
Candidate: cand-6ZRVTS6MW6DT2N6GQT93M84D14
Commit: f4a2195d5599c7ded2e7882390cca68c40ab5bbf
Parent and base: 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5
Tree: 705191a284b85cf8fd6cbe48162ae09f8a963987
Artifact digest: 9410df0b9cb9af9d352b2bbf037e3f24decdd15d6d2656c7b31289092d13c1d6
Reproducible digest: ded486a6777467ce4f8bdd6577af11f8980b3f823dea3e7fb39baef6b2165441

METHOD AND IDENTITY

Read-only review from a git archive of the exact candidate commit. Git independently confirms the stated SHA, direct parent, and a diff confined to mockups/mockup-v2-design-brief.md and mockups/v2. I ran verify-manifest.cjs and fixture-court.cjs from that export; both exited zero and reproduced the registered artifact, projection, fixture, span, and mutation receipts. I inspected every one of the 13 final PNG plates at original pixel resolution and scanned every frozen HTML twin, editable source, the brief, fixture notes, proof boundary, and manifest. No repository file was edited or staged.

PRIOR BLOCKER DISPOSITION

UX-B1 PASS — Frozen semantics and metadata are now truthful. All 13 manifest plates have the visible FROZEN DESIGN SPECIFICATION — CONTROLS ARE INERT notice, lang=en, a unique frozen-design title, viewport metadata, no script, and zero active semantics. Independent search found no role=button, aria-pressed, nonnegative tabindex, or event-handler residue in the frozen plates. The generated global cursor override removes pointer affordance. The proof boundary explicitly says that drawn controls are specifications rather than working controls. Evidence: portable-browser-court evid-6b82eaef458a8dae710d89098d495c00b09b22081799b0dac8dd8cc5891bcb32 and the manifest per-plate activeSemantics=0 courts.

UX-B2 PASS AS A DESIGN CONTRACT — FocusOrder now chooses one coherent pattern: inert SVG paint with aria-hidden=true and focusable=false, plus one visible DOM composite owner using aria-activedescendant and no descendant tabindex. The matrix twin is specified as an 11 × 16 grid containing every zero, source, named off-source, and Unranked cell; arrows, Home and End, Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End, selection, headers, identity, mass, and state announcements are all declared. Printable commands use modifiers, are scoped, remappable, disableable, and suspended in editable controls. PROOF-BOUNDARY correctly keeps the live accessibility tree and keyboard traversal as application-level courts rather than claiming static proof.

UX-B3 PASS — Exact evidence now uses the declared reading token. Manifest computed-style courts report Main 10, RecallMatrix 23, InterviewMode 11, Compact 17 exact-evidence runs at 16px and 24.8px, and Reflow at the 200 percent specimen size of 32px and 48px. No exact-evidence run is clamped or clipped. Dense matrix labels remain explicitly identified as summaries while both source and recall observations remain full-size DOM rails. The original 11px to 12.5px evidence regression is gone.

UX-B4 PASS — Compact contains s01 through s10 in the DOM, uses a declared vertical scroll region, reports 10 of 10 loaded and s10 reachable, and the independent court scrolls every referenced observation into the region. The misleading Page 1 of 1 claim and silent s07 to s10 omission are gone.

UX-B5 PASS — StateBoard now has a separate Provider or compiler failed card with FAILED — NO VALUE EMITTED, failed stage, provider, error code, attempt, retry policy, and last-valid policy. Its heavy border, exclamation glyph, and wording survive without colour. It is explicitly distinguished from Loading, No data, Missing, Unresolved, and Stale build.

UX-B6 PASS — Main and Compact now say synthetic design fixture — unadmitted, not human adjudicated. Search finds no researcher-reviewed fixture claim. fixtures.json, FIXTURE-NOTES, plate headers and manifest agree that the observations and all derived values are synthetic design material, not admitted source, model output, or human adjudication.

FRESH VISUAL AND ACCESSIBILITY SCAN

The persistent-Codex, one-replaceable-projection, collapsible-inspector hierarchy remains clear across Main, Compact, known-source recall, and interview mode. Selection, keyboard focus, epistemic status, missingness, off-source state, and abstention retain independent shape, line, texture, position, and wording channels. Grayscale and three dichromat simulations remain readable. Reflow preserves exact text rather than shrinking it, provides a tabular peer for the pannable projection, and turns the inspector into a disclosure. Reduced motion remains a true zero-millisecond state change with tether, ghost, breadcrumb, announcement, and receipt intact. Original-resolution inspection found no new clipped scientific content or unreadable label family.

NONBLOCKING FOLLOW-UP NOTES

1. The known-source Dual Narrative Codex remains 300px wide. At 16px monospace this is a narrow reading measure, although it is now legible, exact, complete, and scrollable, and a Dual rails mode is visibly specified. The live Dual rails mode should widen the reading measure and the runtime reflow court should test it; do not let the corrected font size become the final word on long-form comfort.
2. FocusOrder calls the scheme twelve tab stops while also saying Tab walks inspector fields and moves between four control groups. Before runtime implementation, distinguish twelve task regions or entry points from the actual tabbable count so the contract can be tested literally.
3. The absolute frozen notice overlaps the trailing secondary banner metadata on Tokens and RendererGap at original resolution. The dominant synthetic label and repeated receipts remain visible, so this does not obscure a scientific claim, but a future export polish should reserve top-right banner space instead of painting over provenance text.

PROOF BOUNDARY

This approval is for the exact static design bundle. It does not certify live keyboard behavior, screen-reader output, 200 percent runtime reflow, reduced-motion execution, privacy enforcement, scientific computation, export behavior, a production renderer, an Intaglio API, or the unresolved graph-over-text spike. Those remain explicitly open in PROOF-BOUNDARY and the brief.

Formal disposition: APPROVE exact candidate f4a2195d5599c7ded2e7882390cca68c40ab5bbf for UX, accessibility design, and visual handoff. This review does not authorize, land, merge, push, or approve any runtime or upstream change.
